messages.text:
The deliverables are now just the Python port, `compile.sh`, and the Windows `.cmd` launcher.

I’m running one normalized comparison pass against the official binary so I can catch remaining stdout/stderr/status mismatches without being fooled by elapsed-time jitter.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, re, pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
ours=['python','zip_password_finder.py']
cases=[
 ['--version'],
 [],
 ['-i','nope.zip'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-c','l','--maxPasswordLen','2','--workers','1'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-c','l','--maxPasswordLen','1','--workers','1'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-p','rust-reference/test-files/generated-passwords-lowercase.txt','--workers','1'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','--mask','?l?l','--workers','1'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','--mask','?1?l','--customCharset1','a','--workers','1'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/multi-file-with-dir.zip','-c','l','--maxPasswordLen','2','--workers','1'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','--workers','0'],
 ['-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-c','x','--maxPasswordLen','1'],
]
def norm(s):
 s=s.replace('\\r\\n','\\n')
 return re.sub(r'Time elapsed: .*\\n','Time elapsed: <time>\\n',s)
for args in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([ref]+args,capture_output=True,text=True)
 o=subprocess.run(ours+args,capture_output=True,text=True)
 ok=(r.returncode==o.returncode and norm(r.stdout)==norm(o.stdout) and norm(r.stderr)==norm(o.stderr))
 print('CASE',args,'OK' if ok else 'DIFF')
 if not ok:
  print('ref',r.returncode,repr(norm(r.stdout)),repr(norm(r.stderr)))
  print('our',o.returncode,repr(norm(o.stdout)),repr(norm(o.stderr)))
'@ | python -"

import subprocess, pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
for args in [['-h'],['--help']]:
 r=subprocess.run([ref]+args,capture_output=True,text=True)
 o=subprocess.run(['python','zip_password_finder.py']+args,capture_output=True,text=True)
 print(args, r.returncode==o.returncode and r.stdout.replace('\\r\\n','\\n')==o.stdout.replace('\\r\\n','\\n') and r.stderr==o.stderr, len(r.stdout), len(o.stdout))
 if r.stdout.replace('\\r\\n','\\n')"'!=o.stdout.replace('"'\\r\\n','\\n'):
  import difflib
  print(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(r.stdout.replace('\\r\\n','\\n').splitlines(True), o.stdout.replace('\\r\\n','\\n').splitlines(True), n=2))[:2000])
'@ | python -"
